chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Isma'il ibn Hammam from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): Regarding

a man who bequeathed wealth to his relatives at the time of his death and freed a slave, and all that he bequeathed exceeded one-third. How is to be done with his bequest? He said, 'Start with the manumission, and it is executed.'
ai.seo_question: What is the priority between freeing a slave and fulfilling bequests if the total exceeds one-third of the estate?
ai.summary: In this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the principle of 'priority of manumission' (Tard al-'itq) is established, ensuring the slave's freedom is secured before any bequests are paid from the estate. This reflects the high spiritual status of freeing slaves in Shia jurisprudence, where the act of emancipation is prioritized over financial obligations to relatives when resources are insufficient to cover both. The decision underscores the merit of 'itq as a form of worship that takes precedence in the distribution of the deceased's assets.
